evidence_summary: Official producer notes support a smooth oak, vanilla, fruit, and spice profile; peat/smoke is intentionally low.
Producer source supports bourbon notes in the vanilla, caramel, oak, spice, and medium-body range.
Official Islay profile strongly supports peat smoke, coastal salinity, body, and a long intense finish.
Producer and retailer sources support a bright Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc profile with citrus, tropical fruit, and high acidity.
Official Beaujolais-Villages source supports a light red Gamay profile with fresh red fruit and moderate acidity/tannin.
Official Guinness source supports roasted malt, dark beer bitterness, nitrogen creaminess, and moderate body.
Official brand positioning supports a crisp, dry lager profile with high carbonation and moderate bitterness.
IBA recipe ingredients support a bitter, herbal, spirit-forward aperitif with orange-citrus garnish influence.
IBA recipe supports a tequila sour profile centered on lime acidity, citrus, moderate sweetness, and optional salt.
Official Hwayo source supports a clean distilled-soju candidate; detailed sensory notes are limited, so confidence is conservative.
Official makgeolli page supports a fresh rice-wine profile with low alcohol, gentle sweetness, acidity, and soft body.
Official Dassai source supports an aromatic junmai daiginjo profile with fruit and floral emphasis.
Official iichiko source supports a clean barley-shochu profile; detailed sensory dimensions remain candidate-level.
Official source supports a London dry botanical profile led by juniper/herbal and citrus-spice traits.
Official Hendrick's source supports cucumber/rose style cues, mapped to floral, herbal, and approachable gin traits.
Official Bacardi source supports a light white-rum mixing profile; detailed flavor dimensions need review by category curator.
Official Appleton source supports a fuller Jamaican rum candidate with fruit, spice, and medium body.
Official Patron source supports a blanco tequila candidate with agave, citrus, and cocktail versatility.
Official Del Maguey sources support roasted agave, smoke, earthiness, and strong cocktail utility.
Official Absolut source supports a neutral vodka candidate; values intentionally avoid inventing strong flavor traits.
Official Grey Goose source supports a premium neutral vodka profile with restrained flavor values and high mixing versatility.
Official Hennessy source supports a matured Cognac profile mapped to oak, dried fruit, spice, and medium-full body.
Official Remy Martin source supports fruit, floral, oak, and spice notes typical of VSOP Cognac.
Official Baileys source supports a sweet cream liqueur profile with vanilla/cocoa/dessert use cases.
Official Kahlua source supports a coffee liqueur profile centered on sweetness, coffee roast, and cocktail versatility.
